note: The tunnel's state, asked of the control server from beside it, presenting nothing. Gluetun started from the role file lemonfiber writes into its configuration directory before its first start, which opens this route only to the key lemonfiber minted, so the server refuses the request. Taken with the stand-ins the manifest declares for OPENVPN_PASSWORD, OPENVPN_USER, VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, VPN_TYPE, WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES, WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_IP, WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_PORT, WIREGUARD_PRESHARED_KEY, WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY, WIREGUARD_PUBLIC_KEY, never with an operator's value.
